details:
In select worlds that I've been too (For example, Nanosys-NightClub-, Bright Lights, etc. older worlds maybe?), I'm having issues where I can't hear newer dated YouTube videos with certain video players. 

However, my group of friends and I found out that if you played older YT videos that they would play properly in those worlds. This only happens in certain worlds. I can hear all of the video's audio on the video player in newer worlds in VRC.

I just wanted to put this out there to the VRC devs. This may be an issue on YouTube's side or the video player creator's side.
Here are my two test videos that I'm using to validate worlds currently:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DgvePeDIt3Y (Has worked in all video players that I have been to so far. Note that the year of upload is 2009.)

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CJ68kQLS250 (Works in newer worlds/video players. Note that the year of upload is 2020.)
title: Video players not playing audio consistently between videos.
